summary: The PR addresses the issue of Pylint not respecting ignore settings in recursive mode but introduces some complexity.

issues.description: The added logic for handling directories recursively adds complexity and could be simplified. For example, the filtering of directories and files could be done in a more streamlined manner.
The code style could be improved for consistency with the rest of the repository. For instance, the indentation and spacing around operators could be adjusted to match Pylint's style guide.
